Proper Grading for Better Drainage and a Level Yard

Serving Omaha Metro

Is your yard in Omaha more of a lumpy, bumpy mess than a smooth, green oasis? Do you have puddles that stick around for days after a classic Nebraska thunderstorm, especially near your foundation? A poorly graded yard isn't just ugly—it can cause serious water issues for your home.

My name is Bryan, and at A1, we've seen it all. From yards in older Papillion homes that have settled over decades to new constructions in Gretna where the final grading was an afterthought. We're not a big, faceless company; we're your neighbors, and we specialize in fixing these exact problems with professional yard grading and leveling.

Stop Water Problems Before They Start

The single most important reason to grade your yard properly is to control water. Here in the Omaha area, we get heavy rains and quick snow melts. If your yard slopes toward your house, all that water is heading straight for your foundation, which can lead to leaks, cracks, and a wet basement. A properly graded yard acts like a shield, directing water away from your home and into the street or a designated drainage area.

We don't just push dirt around. We use precise measurements to establish the correct slope—it doesn't take much—to ensure gravity does the work. This protects your biggest investment and gives you peace of mind every time it rains.

The Perfect Canvas for Your Dream Lawn

Trying to get a beautiful lawn on lumpy, uneven ground is a losing battle. You can't mow it evenly, and it's easy to trip or twist an ankle. Leveling the surface creates a smooth, safe, and beautiful foundation for whatever you have planned, whether it's a lush carpet of grass or a new patio.

Once we've established the right grade, we can create a perfectly level surface. This is the critical first step before any new sod installation. A level yard is easier to maintain, looks a hundred times better, and makes your entire property feel more polished and professional.

What Our Grading & Leveling Service Includes

When you hire A1 for a grading project, we handle everything from start to finish. We're thorough and make sure the job is done right the first time. Here’s what you can expect:

Initial Site Assessment

We'll walk the property with you to understand your goals and identify problem areas and drainage patterns.

Precise Grading

Using professional equipment, we'll reshape the sub-grade to create the necessary slope away from your home.

Surface Leveling

We smooth and prepare the top layer of soil, creating a flat, even surface ready for seeding, sod, or other landscaping.

Final Site Cleanup

Our job isn't done until the site is clean. We'll handle all aspects of the yard cleanup, leaving your property ready to enjoy.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I know if my yard needs to be graded?

If you notice water pooling near your foundation, soggy spots that never seem to dry, or have a lumpy, uneven surface that's difficult to mow, your yard likely needs grading. Proper grading directs water away from your home and creates a more usable, attractive lawn.

What's the difference between grading and leveling?

Grading specifically refers to creating a slope to manage water drainage, ensuring water flows away from your house. Leveling is more about smoothing the surface for aesthetic and functional purposes, like creating a flat area for a patio or playground. Often, a project involves both.

Can you grade a yard that already has grass?

Yes, but it depends on the situation. For minor adjustments, we can sometimes work with the existing turf. For significant changes, the existing grass and topsoil are typically removed, the subgrade is corrected, and then new topsoil and sod or seed are installed.

How much does yard grading cost in Omaha?

The cost varies widely based on the size of your yard, the amount of correction needed, and accessibility for our equipment. We provide free, detailed estimates so you know the exact price before we start any work. It's usually more affordable than people think.
